prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 多级表头 · 半年度指标 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 6 columns × 5 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "指标" spans 1 col × 2 row; "2023 年" spans 2 col × 1 row; "2024 年" spans 2 col × 1 row; "备注" spans 1 col × 2 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "指标" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 123px
  col 2: header "2023 年 › 上半年" · longest unbreakable word 45px · one-line width 46px
  col 3: header "2023 年 › 下半年" · longest unbreakable word 45px · one-line width 46px
  col 4: header "2024 年 › 上半年" · longest unbreakable word 45px · one-line width 46px
  col 5: header "2024 年 › 下半年" · longest unbreakable word 43px · one-line width 46px
  col 6: header "备注" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 349px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 720px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 719px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"展示营收、毛利率和研发投入在 2023 年与 2024 年各半年的变化，并用备注补充背景。","reading":"读者先按行识别指标，再横向比较四个半年度数值，最后查看同一行的备注；也可纵向扫描某一半年的各项指标。备注较长的行产生的行高可容纳同一行指标名称的换行。","groups":["第 2、3 列同属 2023 年，第 4、5 列同属 2024 年；四列都是半年度数值，应保持一致的宽度和比较节奏。","第 1 列是行标题，第 6 列是对应行的文字说明；两者分别承担识别和解释作用。"],"keep_intact":["半年度标签、数值及百分号应保持完整，避免拆行。","指标名称中的单位“亿元”应尽量保持完整。"],"may_wrap":["备注中的中文说明可自然换行，尤其是营业收入一行。","空间紧张时，较长的指标名称可在名称与单位之间换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [144, 68, 68, 68, 68, 303] · table 720×206px · row heights [36, 36, 60, 36, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/8 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [144, 67, 67, 67, 67, 307] · table 720×206px · row heights [36, 36, 60, 36, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/8 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1C: widths [144, 73, 73, 73, 73, 283] · table 720×206px · row heights [36, 36, 60, 36, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/8 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"四个半年度列等宽，年份分组清楚，数值和表头均保持完整；指标名称完整，三行数据容易横向对应。","problems":"营业收入的备注在“1.2”与“个百分点”之间换行，读者需要跨行拼合数量表达；第二行也较短。","cause":"备注列宽303px，可用文字宽度不足以容纳完整的“1.2个百分点”。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"比较列等宽且内容完整，指标名称不换行；备注列比 r1A 稍宽。","problems":"整体与 r1A 很接近，营业收入备注仍在“1.2”与“个百分点”之间换行，增加的备注宽度没有明显改善阅读。","cause":"四个半年度列各缩窄1px后，备注列增至307px，但仍未达到让该数量表达完整落在同一行所需的宽度。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"四个半年度列宽裕且节奏一致；营业收入备注中的“1.2个百分点”完整地落在第二行，行内数量关系清楚。","problems":"半年度列相对内容略宽，备注列因此较窄；首行备注的两行长短差异较大。","cause":"四个半年度列各占73px，压缩了备注列至283px，使“1.2个百分点”整体移到第二行。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"紧凑比较列","widths":[144,66,66,66,66,311],"change":"保留完整指标名称，将半年度列收至刚好容纳最长表头和数值的宽度，把空间交给备注，检查是否能改善首行备注的断行。"},{"name":"优先备注","widths":[130,68,68,68,68,317],"change":"适度缩窄指标列并扩大备注列；较长指标名称可能在名称与单位之间换行，可利用营业收入备注已有的行高，换取更宽的说明文字。"},{"name":"平衡间距","widths":[144,70,70,70,70,295],"change":"以 r1C 为基础略收窄四个半年度列，在保留舒展比较节奏的同时增加备注宽度，观察数量表达和两行长度的平衡。"}]}
